Update 16 to Frenetic roguelike shooter Sweet Surrender is out now on PlayStation VR2!

**New Features:**
* Third Chip Slot on each arm  
* 55+ new upgrade chips  
* Couch Comfort mode and various QoL Improvements

Fight your way to the top of a dystopian Megatower using guns, grenades, swords, snipers, and everything else at your disposal in frenetic VR shooter Sweet Surrender.

Engage in agile combat, running, teleporting or even ziplining across the battleground in perfect comfort. Pick from a wide variety of firearms and melee weapons, and use overpowered upgrades to turn yourself into a customized combat machine – from electromagnetic blasts to even slowing down time. No two runs are the same: as you fight you’ll discover shortcuts and hidden levels, and unlock new classes that change your playstyle.

It's your turn to build an empire that stands the Test of Time.

Test of Time –  a comprehensive free update to the core Civilization VII experience based on community feedback across every Age, releases on May 19, 2026.

⬢ START & STAY AS ONE CIV ⬢
Customize your empire's evolution with unique cultural combinations to build a truly legendary civilization.

⬢ VICTORIES REWORK ⬢
A completely reworked Victory system that provides rewards across all Ages along your chosen path.

⬢ NEW TRIUMPH SYSTEM ⬢
Achieve over 90 new objectives by earning Triumphs for valuable bonuses.

⬢ AND MUCH MORE, INCLUDING... ⬢
- A FREE New Leader
- A New Map Type
- Upgraded Map Generation
